<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 420" width="500" height="420">
  <!-- White background rect -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="500" height="420" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Axes -->
  <!-- Y-axis -->
  <line x1="80" y1="360" x2="80" y2="40" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="80,32 75,44 85,44" fill="#000000" />
  
  <!-- X-axis -->
  <line x1="80" y1="360" x2="450" y2="360" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="458,360 446,355 446,365" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Axis Labels (Maths / Science standard: Times New Roman for variables/labels sometimes, but prompt says sans-serif for science) -->
  <text x="80" y="30" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">Energy</text>
  <text x="440" y="380" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" text-anchor="end" fill="#000000">Progress of reaction</text>

  <!-- Energy Levels -->
  <!-- Reactants level: y = 140, from x = 110 to 150 -->
  <line x1="110" y1="140" x2="160" y2="140" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="135" y="130" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">Reactants</text>

  <!-- Products level: y = 260, from x = 360 to 410 -->
  <line x1="360" y1="260" x2="410" y2="260" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="385" y="250" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">Products</text>

  <!-- Curves -->
  <!-- Uncatalysed curve (solid): Peak at y = 80, x = 260 -->
  <path d="M 160 140 C 200 140, 210 80, 260 80 C 310 80, 320 260, 360 260" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Catalysed curve (dashed): Peak at y = 110, x = 260 -->
  <path d="M 160 140 C 200 140, 215 110, 260 110 C 305 110, 320 260, 360 260" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

  <!-- Labels for curves -->
  <!-- Without catalyst pointing to solid peak -->
  <text x="280" y="65" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#000000">without catalyst</text>
  <line x1="280" y1="69" x2="265" y2="80" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- With catalyst pointing to dashed peak -->
  <text x="310" y="105" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#000000">with catalyst</text>
  <line x1="305" y1="108" x2="278" y2="112" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Double headed arrow for Ea (from reactant level y=140 to peak y=80 at x=210) -->
  <line x1="210" y1="140" x2="210" y2="80" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="210,75 206,85 214,85" fill="#000000" />
  <polygon points="210,145 206,135 214,135" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="198" y="114" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="15" text-anchor="end" fill="#000000">E</text>
  <text x="204" y="117" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="11" text-anchor="end" fill="#000000">a</text>

  <!-- Arrow for Delta H (from reactant level y=140 down to product level y=260 at x=340) -->
  <line x1="340" y1="140" x2="340" y2="260" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="340,135 336,145 344,145" fill="#000000" />
  <polygon points="340,265 336,255 344,255" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="355" y="204" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="15" fill="#000000">ΔH</text>

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="250" y="405" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#000000">Fig. 4.1</text>
</svg>
